    Extraction of jointly stable dependent semibricks #

    Theorem 3.1 (thm:extraction) of the manuscript:

    • exists_rationally_dependent_stable_semibrick: from any pair of nonzero modules M, N with [M] = [N] and Hom(M, N) = 0, one extracts a nonempty finite semibrick whose dimension vectors are linearly dependent and whose members are simultaneously stable at one integral weight.
    • rationally_independent_and_jointly_stable_of_equalClassHom: consequently, under (K₀-Hom), every finite semibrick has linearly independent dimension vectors and admits a single integral weight at which all its members are stable.
    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.rationalClass_independent_iff {G : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup G] {ι : Type u_2} (v : ι → G) :
    (LinearIndependent ℚ fun (i : ι) => 1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] v i) ↔ LinearIndependent ℤ v

    Rationalization preserves and reflects independence of an integral family.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_rationally_dependent_stable_semibrick (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] {M N : FGModuleCat R} (hm : ¬CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero M) (hc : GrothendieckGroup.of M = GrothendieckGroup.of N) (hh : ∀ (f : M ⟶ N), f = 0) :
    ∃ (s : Finset (CategoryTheory.Skeleton (FGModuleCat R))) (g : ProjectiveClass R), IsSemibrick ↑s ∧ ↑s ⊆ stableClasses ((projectiveClassWeight k) g) ∧ ¬LinearIndependent ℚ fun (x : ↥s) => 1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] GrothendieckGroup.of ((CategoryTheory.fromSkeleton (FGModuleCat R)).obj ↑x)

    A nonzero equal-class pair with vanishing Hom yields a semibrick stable at one integral projective weight and dependent in the rational Grothendieck group.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.rationally_independent_and_jointly_stable_of_equalClassHom (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] (h : EqualClassHom (FGModuleCat R)) (s : Finset (CategoryTheory.Skeleton (FGModuleCat R))) (hs : IsSemibrick ↑s) :
    (LinearIndependent ℚ fun (x : ↥s) => 1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] GrothendieckGroup.of ((CategoryTheory.fromSkeleton (FGModuleCat R)).obj ↑x)) ∧ ∃ (g : ProjectiveClass R), ↑s ⊆ stableClasses ((projectiveClassWeight k) g)

    Under equal-class Hom every finite semibrick is simultaneously stable at an integral weight and its classes are rationally independent.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_projective_weight_stable_of_equalClassHom (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] (h : EqualClassHom (FGModuleCat R)) {B : FGModuleCat R} (hb : IsBrick B) :
    ∃ (g : ProjectiveClass R), ((projectiveClassWeight k) g).IsStable B

    In particular, each brick admits an integral stabilizing weight.
